abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same side effects.
conclusion: In the end, the evidence on each measure reads like this. Overall, Brostamide increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same side effects.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. This comparison was run at the Northgate Heart Cohort.

Table 3. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 139 | 550 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Side effects | 160 | 550 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, University hospital | Alvenor | Side effects | 129 | 550 |
